Title: Data Science Engineer
Location: Centro de San Pedro Garza García, Nuevo León, Mexico
Description: ROLE PURPOSE Build the data foundation and data science capabilities that enable artificial intelligence across our engineering organization. Connect, organize and maintain the data that engineering teams create every day, such as requirements, designs, test results, reviews and issue reports, so it can be used reliably by AI solutions, analytics and engineers themselves. Develop analyses and predictive models that turn engineering data into insights and better decisions. Measure how engineering work is performed today and how AI improves it, giving the organization clear and trustworthy evidence of value. Work independently with AI engineers, engineering teams and IT to deliver data that is high quality, secure and easy to use, and act as the team’s technical reference for data and data science. KEY FUNCTIONAL OBJECTIVES Reliable, well-organized engineering data available for AI solutions, analytics and reporting. Clear measurement of engineering processes before and after AI adoption, showing real impact. Analytics and predictive models that help engineering teams anticipate issues and make better decisions. Fast access to approved, ready-to-use data so new AI ideas can be tested quickly. Data quality and consistency that engineers and leaders can trust. Secure and responsible data handling that protects company and customer information. Reusable data pipelines and tools that make each new AI solution faster and cheaper to build. Main Responsibilities Data Integration & Pipelines Design, build and operate data pipelines that collect data from engineering tools, such as requirements management, version control, testing systems and issue trackers. Create and maintain a common data model so information from different teams and projects can be combined and compared. Automate data updates, monitoring and alerts so pipelines run reliably with minimal manual effort. Document data sources, owners and data flows in a catalog that is easy for others to use. Lead the design of the team’s data architecture and tooling (for example, Databricks, Azure and Git-based workflows) within IT-approved platforms. Data Quality & Structure Define and track data-quality rules for completeness, consistency, duplicates and missing links between related records. Identify gaps between related engineering information, for example requirements that have no associated test, and report them to the owning teams. Work with engineering teams to fix data issues at the source. Turn unstructured content, such as documents and spreadsheets, into structured and searchable data. Measurement, Analytics & Data Science Measure how engineering processes perform today, including effort, rework, waiting time and defects, to create a reliable starting point. Develop statistical analyses and predictive models on engineering data to identify trends, risks and improvement opportunities, and validate results with engineering teams. Build dashboards that show AI adoption, quality and business impact over time. Track how engineers accept or reject AI suggestions so the quality of each AI solution can be measured and improved. Provide clear, reproducible data to support business cases and leadership decisions. Data for AI Solutions Prepare data for AI applications, including document processing, search indexes and embeddings used by large language models. Build and maintain test datasets, created together with engineers, to evaluate AI solutions before and after each change. Provide safe datasets, including synthetic or anonymized data where needed, so prototypes can start quickly. Support the move of successful prototypes into production with robust, scalable data pipelines. Data Governance & Security Apply company information-classification and access rules to every dataset and environment. Use only approved tools and platforms, protecting intellectual property and customer information. Keep clear records of data sources, changes and usage to support audits and quality reviews. Partner with IT and information security on data policies and incident prevention. Collaboration & Technical Leadership Act as the data partner for AI engineers, engineering teams, IT and business stakeholders. Join conversations with engineering teams to understand how they work and where their data comes from. Act as technical reference for data and data science within the team; coach the AI Engineer, Jr. AI Engineer and intern on data quality, analytics and self-service reporting. Lead data and analytics workstreams or project steps end to end with minimal guidance. Experience & Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Data Engineering, Electronics, Mechatronics or a related field; advanced degree or data certifications are a plus. 5+ years of experience in data engineering or data science, including building and operating production data pipelines. Advanced Python and SQL; solid experience with data modeling, data orchestration and data-quality practices. Solid knowledge of statistics, machine learning and predictive modeling applied to business or engineering data. Experience with cloud data platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric and Power BI. Experience integrating data from business or engineering tools through APIs (for example, Jira, Git or similar). Experience preparing data for AI and large language model applications, such as document processing, embeddings, vector search and test datasets. Knowledge of data governance, access control and data-security practices. Experience in automotive, electronics or other engineering-driven industries is a plus. Familiarity with automotive engineering processes such as Automotive SPICE (ASPICE) is a plus. Fluent English and Spanish, with the ability to explain data topics clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. Establish clear accountability, strengthen leadership and technical capabilities, and foster collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement across the teams. Executive Communication and Business Recommendations. Present an integrated view of merchandising performance, financial outlook, assortment opportunities, and catalog coverage to senior leadership, highlighting business implications, trade-offs, and recommended actions Lead a team of 24+ professionals in areas as Merchandising Analytics, Content and Assortment A Master's degree (MA, MS, MBA) or equivalent. Engineering, Finance or Accounting. More than seven years. Proven experience leading cross-functional teams in catalog content management, data-driven assortment strategy, and coverage acceleration, with a strong background in analytics, merchandising, and operational execution. Title: Full Stack AI Engineer, Associate
Description: About This Role Your team Technology & Development Operations sits within Platform Ecosystem & Artificial Intelligence (AI) Engineering, part of BlackRock’s Platform Enablement organization. We build production software and reusable engineering patterns that modernize workflows across Business Operations and Client Services. The team partners closely with Aladdin Engineering and other technology teams to deliver full-stack AI applications, intelligent document processing, retrieval-augmented generation, workflow automation, and data-driven operational tools. We focus on turning validated ideas into secure, reliable, and reusable production capabilities rather than isolated demonstrations. Your role and impact As a Full-Stack AI Engineer, you will turn complex operational problems into well-designed software across the user-interface, backend, data, and AI layers. Your work may include React and TypeScript experiences, Python application programming interfaces (APIs), orchestration services, document-processing pipelines, semantic and vector retrieval, large language model (LLM) workflows, and the production controls needed to operate these systems responsibly. You do not need to be a machine-learning researcher. We are looking for a strong software engineer who knows how to make AI capabilities useful, testable, secure, and reliable for real users. Your responsibilities Responsibilities In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities: Design, build, test, and deploy full-stack applications using Python and modern JavaScript or TypeScript frameworks, supported by automated testing and AI evaluations covering correctness, grounding, reliability, and failure cases. Develop backend APIs, orchestration services, and application data models for interactive and long-running workflows using relational and non-relational databases. Build user-facing review and approval experiences that integrate governed language-model, document-intelligence, embedding, semantic-search, vector-search, and source-grounded generation capabilities. Apply secure software-delivery practices, including continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), logging, monitoring, troubleshooting, and disciplined validation of AI-assisted code. Partner with domain experts, Aladdin Engineering, and other technology teams to understand workflows, identify appropriate automation, and integrate applications with shared platforms and services. Create reusable components, engineering patterns, and documentation that make future applications faster, safer, and easier to maintain. Your experience Four or more years of professional software-engineering experience building and shipping applications, supported by a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience. Strong Python programming skills and experience developing backend services, designing APIs, testing software, using Git and code review, supporting continuous delivery, and deploying applications in cloud or managed-platform environments. Experience with JavaScript or TypeScript and a modern frontend framework such as React or Angular, along with working knowledge of Structured Query Language (SQL), data modeling, and application databases. Hands-on experience building LLM capabilities such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), structured extraction, tool use, prompt workflows, or AI evaluation, with sound judgment when using AI-assisted development tools and familiarity with responsible-AI controls and observability. Ability to break down ambiguous problems, evaluate technical options, and communicate recommendations clearly in professional English and Spanish. Preferred experience with Azure-based storage, database, document-intelligence, and search services, including unstructured-document processing, hybrid retrieval, embeddings, vector databases, reranking, and retrieval evaluation. Preferred familiarity with asynchronous or batch-processing pipelines, Open Container Initiative (OCI) container image packaging and runtime, enterprise-grade container orchestration platforms supporting declarative infrastructure and horizontal scaling, Infrastructure as Code, traditional natural-language processing, custom model deployment or fine-tuning, and regulated financial or operational workflows. Our Benefits To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about. Our hybrid work model BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock. Guidance on AI use for candidates At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self. About BlackRock At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress. This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. Title: Growth Analyst - Paid Media
Description: Súmate a Vemo y activa el cambio con nosotros. ¿Quiénes somos? En Vemo somos un ecosistema integral de electromovilidad. Conectamos tecnología, infraestructura y personas para hacer posible una mejor forma de movernos. Nos mueve hacer que más personas y empresas puedan dar el paso hacia la movilidad eléctrica. Todos los días integramos soluciones y acompañamiento para resolver los retos de esa transición, con las personas al centro de lo que construimos. Y queremos que seas parte. ¿Qué buscamos? Buscamos un Growth Analyst de Paid Media que convierta cada peso invertido en Meta y Google en resultados de negocio medibles, con foco en datos, medición y automatización. Debe tener mentalidad de negocio y ligar el rendimiento de medios con las etapas cruciales del funnel y las unidades de negocio, no con métricas de plataforma. Optimizar la inversión con datos, construir la medición que alimenta a los algoritmos y aplicar IA para que la operación de pauta escale. ¿Cuál será tu misión? Ser dueño/a del rendimiento de la inversión en medios pagados: decides dónde va el siguiente peso con base en el costo por etapa crucial del funnel y el retorno por línea de negocio, y construyes el sistema de medición que le da a Meta y Google señales de clientes reales, no de leads. Tus principales responsabilidades serán: Performance y Optimización de Medios Gestionarás y optimizarás campañas en Meta Ads y Google Ads (Search y Performance Max) para las líneas de negocio de Vemo, con estructura, pujas y audiencias basadas en datos. Asignarás y reasignarás presupuesto entre líneas de negocio, canales y campañas según el costo por etapa crucial del funnel, no según el CPL. Analizarás el performance por cohorte de lead: qué campaña, audiencia y creativo genera clientes que avanzan en el funnel y cuánto cuestan. Diseñarás y leerás experimentos de medios con rigor estadístico: tests de creativos y audiencias, estructuras de campaña, holdouts geográficos e incrementalidad. Traducirás los datos de rendimiento creativo en briefs accionables para diseño y copy: qué hook, formato y ángulo escalar y cuál apagar. Pronosticarás inversión y resultados (escenarios de presupuesto y rendimientos decrecientes por canal) para la planeación mensual. Medición y Atribución Implementarás y mantendrás el tracking de medios: Pixel y Conversions API, etiquetas de Google Ads, GTM, GA4 y taxonomía de UTMs. Implementarás offline conversions: enviarás etapas de Microsoft Dynamics 365 a Meta y Google Ads para que los algoritmos optimicen hacia clientes reales. Construirás la atribución de medios uniendo plataformas de ads, GA4 y Dynamics 365, y reconciliarás las discrepancias entre fuentes. Calcularás y reportarás CAC, costo por etapa y payback por línea de negocio y canal. Automatización y Data Automatizarás, junto con BI, la extracción y consolidación de datos de las plataformas de ads (APIs y conectores) sin archivos manuales. Automatizarás los reportes recurrentes de medios: pacing diario, reporte semanal y revisión mensual de negocio. Operarás un sistema de alertas sobre la inversión: sobre o sub pacing, picos de costo por etapa, caídas de tracking, anuncios rechazados y UTMs rotas. Serás dueño/a del naming convention y del catálogo de métricas de medios: definición, fuente y lógica de cálculo de cada KPI. IA aplicada a Paid Media Montarás agentes y flujos con LLMs para análisis recurrentes de las cuentas: resúmenes de performance, explicación de variaciones y detección de anomalías. Usarás IA para clasificar creativos y copies por ángulo, hook y formato, y leer qué patrones convierten. Reducirás la operación manual de las cuentas con scripts de Google Ads, reglas automatizadas y la API de Meta. Requisitos básicos: 1 a 3 años experiencia en performance marketing o paid media, manejando directamente campañas de Meta Ads y Google Ads (Search y Performance Max) con presupuesto propio. Idealmente en empresas de alto crecimiento con ciclos de venta largos (fintech, movilidad, autos, seguros, leasing o inmobiliario). Conocimiento práctico de Pixel, Conversions API, Google Tag Manager, GA4 y taxonomía de UTMs, y experiencia trabajando con ellos en campañas reales. Excel o Google Sheets avanzado y experiencia construyendo dashboards en Looker Studio, Power BI o similar. Experiencia diseñando y leyendo tests de creativos, audiencias o estructuras de campaña. Licenciatura en Mercadotecnia, Negocios, Economía, Ingeniería o afín. Requisitos deseables: Implementación de offline conversions (envío de etapas del CRM a Meta y Google Ads). Experiencia con CRM conectado a pauta (Microsoft Dynamics 365, Salesforce o HubSpot). Diseño de experimentos de incrementalidad o holdouts geográficos. Scripts de Google Ads, reglas automatizadas o uso de la API de Meta. Uso de IA y LLMs para automatizar análisis o clasificar creativos. Habilidades clave: Análisis de datos con mentalidad de negocio , ligando la inversión con CAC, costo por etapa del funnel y retorno por línea de negocio. Comunicación ejecutiva : explicas a dirección qué pasó, por qué y qué hacer, sin jerga técnica. Proactividad : encuentras oportunidades que nadie te pidió buscar. Rigor analítico : tus conclusiones se sostienen con datos y método. ¿Por qué Vemo? El cambio lo activamos en equipo, y tu talento puede llevarnos más lejos. En Vemo, cada persona aporta experiencias, ideas y perspectivas que nos ayudan a resolver retos y construir mejores soluciones. Aquí queremos que puedas ser tú, compartir lo que sabes y descubrir nuevas formas de crecer. Promovemos un entorno de respeto, inclusión e igualdad de oportunidades. Valoramos a quienes se suman al equipo por sus habilidades y experiencia, sin discriminación por origen, raza, religión, nacionalidad, género, orientación sexual, discapacidad, edad o cualquier otra condición. Trae tus ideas, suma tu talento y crece con nosotros.

Title: Logistics Operations Specialist
Description: About SHEIN SHEIN is a global fashion and lifestyle e-retailer committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all. We use on-demand manufacturing technology to connect suppliers to our agile supply chain, reducing inventory waste and enabling us to deliver a variety of affordable products to customers around the world. From our global offices, we reach customers in more than 160 countries. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has nearly 18,000 employees operating from offices around the world. In SHEIN, we work with outstanding, creative, and capable peers. We share an energetic and open culture for capable people to discern, work and ignite as a team. At SHEIN, our culture is driven by our core values: Customer First, Take Ownership, Deliver Results, Make Change, and Celebrate Diversity. These are not just words, they are the principles that guide our work as we strive to meet the needs of our customers around the world. Job Description (Position Summary – main purpose) The Operations Analyst supports the First Mile, Customs & Brokerage and Last Mile teams with data, reporting, analysis and day-to-day operational follow-up. The role owns the recurring reporting cadence and the KPI source of truth for the three miles, tracks action items and close loops to completion, and provides the analytical basis for carrier and broker performance reviews and for volume allocation decisions. It works under the direction of the Head of Operations and alongside the three mile managers, with no people or budget ownership. Key Responsibilities (main Objectives) Recurring reporting: Prepare the DBR and WBR input packs for FM, CB and LM — KPI extracts, variance commentary and action items ready before each review. Top Management reports: Build the weekly FM, CB and LM Top Management reports — performance, cost and CPP analysis with a clear read-across. KPI source of truth: Maintain KPI definitions and data sources for the three miles; reconcile discrepancies between systems before publication. Dashboards and automation: Maintain dashboards and automate recurring extracts to reduce manual reporting effort. Carrier and broker analysis: Analyse pickup, clearance and delivery performance by carrier, broker and lane; highlight underperformance and its operational impact. Cost per parcel analysis: Track cost per parcel by mile, carrier and channel; quantify the CPP impact of proposed allocation or rate changes. Root cause analysis: Investigate KPI misses, backlog spikes and delivery failures with the mile teams; document findings and recommendations. Scenario analysis: Model volume, capacity and SLA scenarios — peak season, carrier outage, licence suspension — for management decisions. Action item tracking: Maintain the action log across FM, CB and LM; follow up owners and due dates and report status in the DBR and WBR. Close loop monitoring: Track close loop cases — delivery exceptions, complaints, lost parcels — to resolution within SLA; escalate ageing cases. Daily operational follow-up: Follow up carrier collection, clearance backlog and LM handoff issues daily; flag deviations to the mile managers the same day and build incident timelines for escalations. Meeting support: Support the WBR (CN & MX), North America Weekly and CX BiWeekly meetings with data and minutes. Ad-hoc requests: Answer data requests from the Head of Operations, HQ and Finance with validated figures. System and data gaps: Raise system issues and data gaps through the Head of Operations; test fixes before release. KPIs to be Evaluated Report timeliness: DBR / WBR inputs and Top Management packs delivered before the meeting cut-off, at 100% of cycles. Data accuracy: No material restatement (variance above 1%) in any published KPI pack; source-system discrepancies reconciled within 1 business day. Action item closure: Tracked actions closed by their due date at ≥ 90%, with anything ageing beyond 7 days escalated. Close loop tracking: All close loop cases tracked to resolution and ageing cases escalated daily, with ≥ 95% resolved within SLA. Analysis turnaround: Standard analysis requests answered within 2 business days; operational escalations same day. Qualifications and Skills (Requirements - mandatory) Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree in industrial engineering, Logistics, Data Analytics, Economics or Business Administration. Language proficiency: English / Spanish — fluent written and verbal. Experience: 2+ years in logistics operations, last mile / customs analytics or a comparable operations analyst role. Technical skills: Advanced Excel (large datasets, pivot tables); SQL and Power BI or Tableau; Python or R desirable. Analytical: Strong quantitative reasoning — able to move from data to a defensible recommendation. Reporting: Experience building recurring management reports and maintaining KPI definitions. Communication: Clear written English and Spanish; able to explain numbers to non-analysts. Operational awareness: Comfortable in a daily operations cadence with tight deadlines and same-day escalations. Preferred Qualifications (Non mandatory - preferred) Education: Specialist / master’s degree in analytics, supply chain or logistics. Experience with carrier, broker or last mile KPI models. Familiarity with TMS, WMS and customs / brokerage systems. Areas of Interaction & Budget management First Mile, Customs & Brokerage, Last Mile teams, carriers and brokers, CX, Finance, CN HQ Control Tower and the Head of Operations. Budget: no budget ownership. Supports CPP analysis and cost reporting for the three miles; no approval authority over allocation, rates or providers.
